paths: operator calls through the guarded account

prohibited: any call that adds exposure or a new counterparty
mustContinue: reading the principal's own mail and calendar
inFlight: calls already executed stand; calls not yet executed are re-checked and refused unless allowed above

duration.condition: until the principal resumes the binding after reviewing the incident record

resume.condition: incident reviewed and the injected instruction source removed from the assistant's inputs

metadata.note: The restrictions bit set recorded on chain is 1 | 8 = 9; responseRef is the canonical hash of this document.
